$messageId..write:
auth != null &&
            newData.hasChildren(['conversationId', 'conversationType', 'senderId', 'text', 'target', 'createdAt']) &&
            newData.child('senderId').val() === auth.uid &&
            (newData.child('conversationType').val() === 'direct' ||
             newData.child('conversationType').val() === 'group') &&
            newData.child('text').val().length > 0 &&
            newData.child('text').val().length <= 1000 &&
            (newData.child('target').child('type').val() === 'conversation' ||
             (newData.child('target').child('type').val() === 'member' &&
              newData.child('target').child('memberId').val().length > 0))
